title: The Signature Name-Forge Method - Signature Cantonese naming framework
description: Signature original framework for Cantonese names. Forging a new Signature name runs in four passes: sound (two to four syllables that read aloud cleanly), meaning (one plain-language gloss, never a paragraph), lineage (which earlier Signature name it descends from), and check (spoken, written, and searched for collisions). A name is only filed when all four passes are written down. Signature original — not a public record.

title: Signature Sound-First Naming - Signature Cantonese naming framework
description: Signature original framework for Cantonese names. Many strong names are built sound-first: pick a rhythm (STRESS-unstress, or three even beats), fill it with open vowels, and avoid consonant clusters that tangle on the tongue. Only after the sound survives a read-aloud test is a meaning attached. Signature original — not a public record.

title: Signature Meaning-First Construction - Signature Cantonese naming framework
description: Signature original framework for Cantonese names. Meaning-first names start from one plain word — light, stone, river, oath — and grow syllables around it until the word is felt but not spelled out. The record always states the seed word so the construction stays honest. Signature original — not a public record.

description: Signature original framework for Cantonese names.
